I don't have a set fee for late check-out, so I won't quote one. Standard check-out is 11:00. Late check-out is available until 14:00, subject to availability on your departure day.

The front desk can confirm whether a charge applies and whether your date is open. If you tell me your arrival and departure dates, I can pass the request along. Requests are easiest to arrange the day before.

You can keep the room until 14:00 with a late check-out. That's three hours past the standard 11:00 check-out. It depends on availability on your departure day, so it isn't guaranteed.

If you'd like, give me your departure date and I'll note the request. The front desk can confirm it.
